test_title: PYST 5: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 03 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

They cancelled the meeting due to bad weather.

options.text: The meeting is cancelled by them because of bad weather.
The meeting was cancelled due to bad weather.
They cancelled the meeting and bad weather was the cause.
The bad weather is the reason they cancelled the meeting.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The meeting was cancelled due to bad weather.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In an active voice sentence, **the subject performs the action**.
 
• **Active Voice Structure**: Subjec
